title: generation.lesson.failed
description: Generation could not produce a lesson for a request. aggregate_id = request_id, aggregate_version always 3. The requester shows a message for `code` and gives the slot back. off_topic: the request isn't about everyday life in Singapore (the model refused); invalid_output: the lesson failed our checks twice; unsafe: the answer check rejected it; provider: the model couldn't be reached, or generation is switched off. `detail` is for logs only, never shown to learners.
